BiblicalUsage: Dorcas, also called Tabitha, a disciple at Joppa full of good works and almsdeeds, whose death brought the widows to Peter with the coats and garments she had made, and whose raising brought many to believe.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a life of quiet good works is a sermon that outlives the preacher, because the widows showed Peter the coats and the Lord showed Joppa the empty grave.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
